Every model call aider makes goes through the inference proxy.
TOOLS: base, chain, bus_client; db client; machine openai_wire (aider speaks OpenAI's wire format; the shim translates it to the inference proxy, per 5.7.3.8)

Builders are a family: anything that adapts every builder to Cairn goes in a base builder shim class shared by cc, aider, hermes and the rest; a base class, not a device. What adapts one builder stays in that builder's device. (Q#39, answered by Akien's Q#22 answer 2026-11-04; see 20.2)
build_inspector: python sieves run after a build; reds a component that fails one (no charter, no proofs, a silent device, ...). "We find a new thing, we add a new sieve." → CodeMother (10.3.5)

Owns the inspectors and gates (draft, moving from standalone): build_inspector, plan_inspector, ticket_inspector, corrosion, exemptions, rehearsal, determinism, import_sieve, and the tester (11; Q#33, Akien 2026-10-29). (Not diagnostic_inspector: it is base's, 17.3.) The code pipeline's inspectors and gates move to CodeMother; any that are not about code (if such existed) would not. (Q#31, Akien 2026-10-27)
Logging and diagnostics. These can be in different files, mixed in together.
